module: Flowgraph node "Number Slider" (category provider, tag util). Provides up to five numbers adjustable with the mouse, with different ranges: a [-1, 1], b [0, 1], c [0, 10], d [0, 100], e [0, 1000] (modifiable via data.aMin/aMax, bMin/bMax...). Only output a is visible by default; b to e are hidden. The sliders are in the node (for visible pins) and in the properties panel. Values are saved with the graph.

init.desc: Sets the default ranges and the initial values to 0.

drawCustomProperties.desc: Draws the five sliders in the properties panel.

drawMiddle.desc: Editor: draws the sliders of the non-hidden pins.

work.desc: Copies the slider values to pins a to e.

_onSerialize.desc: Saves the values a to e.

_onDeserialized.desc: Restores the values a to e (0 by default).
